messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — vendor has a signed MSA but needs a firm commit plan for 100k qps-month and wants reserved GPUs for a POC. Pricing and security Qs coming. Can we confirm a recommended reserved config and preheat window?
caleb (sales_eng): They said 5k RPS peak, 99th token latency target 200ms, and 40% of traffic is chat (context 2k tokens). Asking about mixed-precision and quantized models to reduce cost.
anya (solutions): For that profile I'd recommend 6 x A100-40GB equivalent as a starting reserve with autoscale bump to +50% for burst windows across 2 AZs. KV-cache warmup will cut token costs 25-35% for repeated session patterns.
tom (infra): Agree on 6 reserved GPUs. Ops notes: ensure AZ spread to tolerate single AZ eviction. Preheat plan: staggered warmup over 2 hours before ramp. We'll run a synthetic smoke test at 75% of requested qps.
caleb (sales_eng): Pricing ask — customer expects a committed discount + burst credits. What's the rough order of magnitude for monthly cost on the 6-reserve baseline (quantized model)?
anya (solutions): Back-of-envelope: baseline (non-quantized) is ~ $X/month per GPU. With 4-bit quantization and batching, expect 40-50% unit cost reduction. I'll attach a short example calc in a follow-up.
infra-bot: deployment-check OK — no conflicting reservations in target region.
maria (AE): Security questionnaire note — they need KMS integration + monthly audit logs retention 13 months. Is Private deployment required or can Dedicated with VPC peering suffice?
legal-liaison: For KMS + audit retention that can be covered under Dedicated with customer-managed KMS and audit-forwarding. Private only required if they need on-prem or air-gapped. Need to confirm DLP scope.
tom (infra): Ops checklist:
```
- Reserve: 6 GPUs (A100/80 equiv) across 2 AZs
- Autoscale: target CPU/GPU util triggers
  - scale_up: if gpu_util > 70% for 30s -> +1 gpu
  - scale_down: if gpu_util < 30% for 5m -> -1 gpu
- Burst policy: allow +50% for up to 4 hrs/day via burst credits
- Preheat: run kv-warmup job: 
  ./kv-warmup --model mix-quant --sessions 2000 --duration 90m
```
caleb (sales_eng): Can we provide a single-number SLA for coldstart P99 during preheat windows? They want contractual wording.
tom (infra): We can commit to P99 latency SLO only when the preheat runbook is followed (preheat window + KV cache warm). Outside of preheat, use best-effort with fallbacks to smaller model — can't sign hard SLA for cold starts.
anya (solutions): Operationally we recommend: include a canary ramp, 2-step rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and automatic fallback to a quantized variant if latency exceeds threshold. That reduces risk.
maria (AE): Sales needs the final numbers for AE deck and quote by EOD. Caleb / Anya can you confirm exact GPUs, monthly cost range (commit and burst), and an example autoscale snippet we can paste in the quote?
anya (solutions): I'll send a short calc thread in 30 min. Example autoscale JSON: 
```json
{"min_reserved_gpus":6, "max_total_gpus":9, "scale_up_threshold":0.7, "scale_down_threshold":0.3, "burst_limit_hrs_per_month":120}
```
caleb (sales_eng): I'll draft pricing language: committed reservation + burst credits (30% discount on committed, 10% for burst use). Need legal to review.
legal-liaison: I'll review the clause about preheat-runbook dependency for latency SLO. Add an ops appendix referencing the KV warmup commands and monitoring hooks.
maria (AE): Final misc: customer asked about license for quantized model (third-party). Any blockers?
anya (solutions): We support open-quantized variants; if it's a licensed third-party model we need model licensing terms in the deal. Ops needs to ensure the model container includes license files and attestation.
caleb (sales_eng): Ok — plan: Anya provides exact cost + autoscale snippet. Tom provides preheat runbook and smoke test checklist. Legal drafts SLO appendix. I'll update AE deck and send quote.
maria (AE): Thanks all. Ping here when docs are ready. :raised_hands:
